blocks.title: A little about me
blocks.text: Welcome. I am Zixuan Bao. This website brings together my research, notes, thoughts, writings, photographs, and useful resources.

blocks.title: Around this website
blocks.text: Research is organized by field, and Notes by subject. Thoughts and Writings collect shorter reflections and longer pieces. Gallery follows places, while Resources keeps useful links close at hand.
